scope: First-class dictation and voice-origin steering; speech synthesis, always-on wake-word listening, and meeting recording are outside this addition.
integration: Supported Wispr client -> editable HMT command composer -> explicit submitted intent -> current admission -> scoped task action -> receipt
native_linux: Not supported by vendor documentation inspected on 2026-10-26; supported client may access HMT web UI subject to qualification.
embedding_api_mcp: Not established from official pages inspected; third-party install-auth skill claims are not accepted as a contract.
cloud_boundary: Wispr audio/cloud processing precedes HMT text ingress. HMT text admission cannot retrospectively prevent provider egress. Qualify device/account/context/retention controls before admitting sensitive dictation.
provenance: Keep HMT-received text and submitted revisions; no claim of raw/verbatim audio or authenticated provider metadata unless actually supplied and verified.
initial_model_candidates: base.en for constrained CPU subject to qualification
future_candidate: NVIDIA Parakeet: documentation only, not primary/alternate
fallback: HMT-owned retained authorized audio may be transcribed locally under current policy; Wispr-only capture requires explicit redictation when raw audio is unavailable. Terminal HOLD and unresolved commands cannot switch providers.
offline: Runtime, model, audio conversion and VAD assets provisioned and pinned before use; deny network during offline qualification. No download at inference time.
